title: Open graph domain from the closed-ball support identity of 5.2
statement: Let S be a subset of R^(n+l), q a linear isometry of R^(n+l), s > 0, and u : R^n -> R^l continuous on the closed ball B^n_s(0) with u(0) = 0, and suppose S cap B_s(0) = q(graph_{B^n_s(0)} u) cap B_s(0) (closed balls; graph_D u = {(x, u(x)) : x in D}, first n coordinates x, last l coordinates u(x)). Then there is an open set W in R^n with 0 in W, W contained in the open ball B'^n_s(0), and q^{-1}(S) cap B'_s(0) = graph_W u (B' = open ball).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ContinuousOn u (closedBall 0 s) → u 0 = 0 → S ∩ closedBall 0 s = q '' graphOver u (closedBall 0 s) ∩ closedBall 0 s → ∃ W : Set (Rn n), IsOpen W ∧ (0 : Rn n) ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ ball 0 s ∧ q.symm '' S ∩ ball 0 s = graphOver u W
